contract_answer.question: On split 2024, does the NA-E026 degradation-law configuration improve MAPE over NA-E011 and complete the fixed three-split A5-NA accuracy, law-fit, and balance rule?
contract_answer.conclusion: Reviewer recomputation from 600 selected-checkpoint predictions confirms MAPE 0.111591, Acc@15 0.756667, and RMSE 24.4526 cycles at epoch 27. MAPE is worse than matched parent NA-E011 (0.109135), so the split-local results.tsv rule gives DISCARD. Held-out law-fit error is 0.0397 versus parent 0.0400 and true-EOL floor 0.0152; excess falls only from 0.0248 to 0.0245 (1.2%). Balance passes with median R 0.381. Three-split MAPE is 0.1049 +/- 0.0121 and balance passes everywhere, but mean law-fit excess falls from 0.0207 to 0.0175 (15.6%), below A5-NA's required 30%; therefore the degradation-law configuration is not promoted.
